title: Workmanship Share Charged on a Replaced Tire — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Workmanship share — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The share charged for a defective tire replaced at an inspection visit is the price per tire on the set's own ticket times the workmanship share percentage divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent, plus the mounting part. The store's selling price on the replacement date does not enter it.

**The inspection entry.** Among the set's inspection entries carrying a defect, the entry that records the defect is chosen in this order: a tread separation, then a belt shift, then a bead leak, then an out-of-round tire — the latest entry of the first defect found. The replacement visit is that entry's date. A set with no inspection entry recording any of these defects has no workmanship share to work out, and its share is 0.00.

**Quantities**
- Tread worn — the line's new-tire depth less that entry's lowest main-groove depth; usable tread — the new-tire depth less the wear-out depth.
- **Free period** — the replacement is free, and the workmanship share is 0.00, while fewer than the line's free-replacement months in whole calendar months have elapsed from the purchase date to the replacement visit and the tread worn is at most the line's free-replacement tread worn.
- Otherwise the prorated share is the tread worn times 100 divided by the usable tread, and the workmanship share percentage is the prorated share.
- Mounting part — the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire when the line charges mounting after the free period, and 0 otherwise.

The workmanship share percentage is never rounded; the price per tire times it divided by 100 is rounded half up to the cent, and the mounting part is added after that rounding.

**Worked (hypothetical set; line with 11/32 in new depth, 2/32 in wear-out, 12 free months, 2/32 in free wear, $25.00 mounting charged after the free period; $140.00 a tire):** a belt shift found 20 months after purchase at 5/32 in — tread worn 6, usable tread 9, prorated share 66.666…; $140.00 times 66.666… divided by 100 is $93.33; plus $25.00, $118.33. The same tire found at 10/32 in 7 months after purchase — free, $0.00.
